classification: retrospective what-if simulation on already inspected backtests; not independent validation
candidate_gate: Existing frozen Plan B candidates only.
selection_frequency: Within each historical weekend, retain at most three Plan B candidates.
target: Player records at least three total shots in the target match.

simulations.flat_singles: $10 on every retained candidate at decimal 1.40
simulations.exact_three_accumulator: $10 only when a weekend supplies three retained candidates; all three must hit; combined decimal odds 1.40^3 = 2.744
simulations.weekend_rollover: Start each cycle at $10 and roll the full return into the next exact-three weekend accumulator; after a losing weekend the cycle reaches $0 and the next eligible weekend restarts with a new $10 deposit.

rules: Do not use target-match outcomes to rank or select candidates.
Do not fill a weekend with Plan A-only candidates when fewer than three Plan B candidates exist.
Do not claim that fixed hypothetical odds were historically available.
Same-weekend and same-match selections are correlated.
This test changes the target from 2+ to 3+ shots and does not inherit the 2+ hit rate.
